QR codes and pasted links are reviewed before anything is saved. Pairing never starts the microphone.
Captions, microphone and session controls. Closing the panel keeps an active session running.

Let z0live read the active app\'s controls and tap, type, scroll and navigate when you ask during a voice session. Stays on until you turn it off. Sensitive apps and password fields are blocked; send, pay, delete, install and permission taps are asked out loud first.

Allow z0live to read the active app\'s control labels and tap, type, scroll and navigate when you ask it to during a voice session? Control labels may reach your voice provider and your z0live desktop. Never share credentials. Banking, password and messaging apps and password fields are blocked. Taps that send, pay, delete, install or grant a permission are asked out loud first. Android Accessibility must also have z0live turned on. This stays on until you turn it off here.
Optional camera permission for the flashlight. Not requested when starting voice.
Camera permission allowed. Tap to manage in Android settings.
Android settings or this integration could not be opened.

Optional in-app control for z0live voice: reads control labels and taps, types and scrolls when you ask during a voice session. Sensitive apps and password fields are blocked; send, pay, delete, install and permission taps are confirmed out loud first.
In-app control is on, but Android Accessibility still has z0live off. Turn it on in Accessibility settings.
Off: turn on z0live under Installed apps
Android says the setting is restricted?
Open App info, tap the menu, choose Allow restricted settings, then turn on z0live in Accessibility.
